tossups.text: This element has atomic number 6 and is the basis of all organic chemistry. It exists in several allotropic forms including diamond and graphite. This element forms the backbone of all known life on Earth. For ten points, name this element whose symbol is C.
tossups.explanation: Carbon (C) is element 6 on the periodic table and forms the basis of organic chemistry. It is essential to all known life.

tossups.text: This American author created the character of Tom Sawyer and wrote about adventures on the Mississippi River. His real name was Samuel Clemens. His most famous work features a boy named Huck who travels down the river on a raft with an escaped slave named Jim. For ten points, name this author of The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn.
tossups.explanation: Mark Twain was the pen name of Samuel Clemens, author of classic American literature including The Adventures of Tom Sawyer and The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn.
